title: Omwoyo Omugga Kiyira Ogubonyaabonyezebwa
intro: Mu mulembe ogw’okunyigirizibwa okunene, omutyobooli bwe yafuganga ensi n’obukambwe obw’enkomeredde, emmeeme emu yalonda ekkubo ly’okukkiriza okusinga okubudaabudibwa kw’obwakabaka. Ekifaananyi kino yabeeranga mu mutima gw’amaanyi naye n’afuna amazima mu bubaka bwa nnabbi omwetoowaze. Olugendo lwabwe lwandifuuse eky’okuyiga ekitaggwaawo mu bugumiikiriza, okwefiiriza, n’okukakasa okutakyukakyuka. Osobola okutegeera omuntu ono ow’ekitalo eyali ayagala ennyo okusanyuka okw’obwakatonda okusinga okubeera okw’ensi?
clues: Nnabeera mu lubiri olw’amaanyi amangi, naye omutima gwange gwasanga amazima mu bubaka obw’obwetoowaze.
Nasalawo okugoberera obulagirizi bwa Musa, nga mmanyi ebiddirira bye nnandiyolekedde.
Nnali mufumbo n’omutyobooli eyali asinga amaanyi mu kiseera kyange, naye ne nneegaana bakatonda be ab’obulimba.
Okubonaabona kwange kwali kwa maanyi, nga bwe nnabonerezebwa olw’okukkiriza kwange mu Katonda Omu.
Ssaawugukanga mu kukkiriza kwange, ne bwe nnayolekagana n’okubonyaabonyezebwa okw’amaanyi ennyo.
Mukama wange yasanyuka olw’obugumiikiriza bwange n’annonda ekifo eky’ekitiibwa mu Jjana.

arabic: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ٱبْنِ لِى عِندَكَ بَيْتًۭا فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِى مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And Allāh presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people." (66:11)
